name: [UPD] Be a Ninja
desc:
⚔️Be A Ninja ⚔️

Do you have what it takes to become the strongest ninja? Gain Skill Points every second, and upgrade your stats in order to defeat ninjas and other players..

How To Play:
🔥Gain Skill Points
💵 Spend Skill Points on upgrades! 
⚒️ Upgrade your weapons!
⚔️ Defeat NPC's and Players!
🪽 Rebirth to unlock new weapons, areas, and other perks!
